Third-party source included in this repository

The directory vendor/egui-winit contains a locally patched copy of
egui-winit 0.37.0 by the egui contributors.

Project: https://github.com/emilk/egui
Crate: https://crates.io/crates/egui-winit/0.37.0
License: MIT OR Apache-2.0

The texts for these licenses are included as:
  third_party/egui/egui-LICENSE-MIT.txt
  third_party/egui/egui-LICENSE-APACHE.txt

Other Rust dependencies are obtained through Cargo and retain their
respective copyright notices and licenses.

The bundled instrument recordings are not from Sky. They are drawn from
Meta Open Sound (Meta Nylon Guitar) and Versilian Community
Sample Library (Folk Harp), all licensed under Creative Commons CC0 1.0
Universal. Original recording URLs and file hashes are listed in
assets/instruments/SOURCES.txt (source repository) or instruments/SOURCES.txt (portable release).
The full CC0 license text is included as assets/instruments/LICENSE-CC0.txt in source and instruments/LICENSE-CC0.txt in the portable release.
